# 00000004734

**English.** Definition: A twisted derived category is the derived sheaf category of a stack with a Brauer class. Conjecture: The index-three class can be generated by two exceptional objects, the generation constant is at most three, and the construction is explicit for all index-three classes. (two-object generation of twisted derived categories)

**中文。** 定义：扭曲导出范畴指带 Brauer 类叠的导出层范畴。猜想：指标三类可由两个例外对象生成,生成常数不超过三且构造对一切指标三类显式。（扭曲导出范畴二元生成）
